name: EMA Cross
description:
Simple, but popular strategy of entering the market when faster EMA crosses above slower EMA.

Rules:
- Enter Long when faster EMA crosses above slower EMA
- Enter Short when faster EMA crosses below slower EMA

name: Inside Bar Breakout
description:
Strategy powerful on higher timeframes - entering at the break of inside bar.

Rules:
- When there is an inside bar (a bar smaller than the bar before) then place two stop orders:
- Long Stop X pips above the inside bar high
- Short Stop X pips below the inside bar low
- Stop Loss is the opposite boundary of inside bar

name: Grid Example 1
description: Example 3-level Martingale strategy. Principle of Grid/Martingale is that after every losing trade it doubles the lots size for the next trade in attempt to compensate the previous losing trade.

name: Range Breakout
description:
Quite powerful strategy of entering the market when price breaks predefined range.

Rules:
- Range is defined by a number of bars in the past
- Enter Long when price breaks above the range
- Enter Short when price breaks below the range
- Use the opposite range boundary as Stop Loss

name: Bearish Divergence
description: Example of strategy trading on bearish divergence between price and MACD

name: Trail Stop by EA
description:
Example how to handle custom trailing stop using AlgoWizard.
Strategy will open an order and then trails the stop loss programtically using AlgoWizard, instead of build-in trailing stop functionality.

name: Trail Stop by Lowest
description: Example of strategy that moves its Stop Loss always to the low of the previous 5 candles.

name: Buy dips
description: Example of strategy that opens position during temporary market drop.

name: Mean reversion
description: Example of strategy that open pending limit order after yesterday's significant price move

name: Breakout
description: Example of strategy that open position after price break its long-term highest value.
